2026_01_CLE_JAX.headline: Cleveland’s interior protection gets an immediate test from Jacksonville’s disciplined front
2026_01_CLE_JAX.paragraph1: Cleveland will be without guard Teven Jenkins and lists center Parker Brailsford as questionable, creating an immediate interior protection concern against a Jacksonville defense that wants to carry last season’s run-stopping identity forward. The Jaguars can make that matter by winning early downs and forcing Cleveland into longer dropbacks. The Browns’ answer is to stay balanced, avoid predictable passing situations and make Jacksonville prove its pass rush has taken the next step.
2026_01_CLE_JAX.model_rationale: Jacksonville can turn Cleveland’s interior availability issues into down-and-distance control, while the Browns need balance to keep protection from becoming the game’s defining weakness.
